sources.title: AI ads impact study
sources.supports: company-reported 22% advertiser ROAS; linked protocol inaccessible

financial_anchor.caveat: Legal charges/severance distort comparison; OCF $31.862bn, capex plus lease principal $31.078bn, FCF $784m; cash/securities $90.26bn and long-term debt $83.66bn.

ai_claim.claim: A Meta-authored study reports 22% higher advertiser ROAS for new AI ad tools and references a large randomized trial.
ai_claim.stage: E2 company-reported advertiser outcome; E3 unverified
ai_claim.limitation: Company-authored and bundled. Newsroom says broader figures are grounded in an RCT, but linked study redirected to login and SSRN returned 403; accessible evidence does not verify the 22% AI-tool uplift itself was randomized. Advertiser revenue is not Meta cash.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Q2 FCF fell to $784m as capex plus lease principal reached $31.078bn; costs grew 55%.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Infrastructure supports non-AI and future workloads, so causality is not fully separable.

rights_limit: User, advertiser conversion, creator and licensed-content data face consent, purpose, platform-policy and jurisdiction limits.
materiality_summary: 5% annualized Q2 operating income is $3.755bn/year; illustrative net ad contribution is $0.710bn/year.
g2_provisional: Provisional: E2 company-reported advertiser outcome and production scale; E3 and retained-cash increment unproven.
unresolved_questions: Rights, safety cost and paid agent retention?
